item.title: Heliocampus Fall 2026 Syllabus Available - Complete by September 10
item.description:
The HelioCampus syllabus module is now available for faculty to access for the fall semester. Based on the requirements from the Provost’s office, faculty should have their syllabi published in HelioCampus by September 10, 2026. HelioCampus will publish all syllabi automatically on September 17, 2026.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
